title_card.headline: Six companies. Every number tied to a decision.

narration: Six companies, and every number tied to a next step.

action_args.text: Show me how to take Punctual Pros nationwide

narration: Ask an operating partner's question. It answers from filings, deed records and add-on screens.

title_card.headline: Lancaster to national in four phases.

narration: Densify the core, tuck in franchisees across four states, build a Mid-Atlantic hub, then consolidate.
Seventy-seven thousand home sales, each a household that just inherited a furnace.
The add-on screen on a map: sixty-one targets, scored and sourced.
Weather Service alerts become a staffing plan: how many technicians, which hub, which day.

title_card.headline: Answer every call, day and night.

narration: A voice agent answers in two rings, books into dispatch and calls members due for renewal.
Connected TV keyed to storm alerts, Local Services Ads and new-mover mail, each with sourced costs.
One hundred eighty-three treatment plants, ranked by fit and funding, so Horton knows who to call.
Each company gets an operating system: the integration spine for tuck-ins and the case for a higher multiple.
One hundred fifty-seven add-on targets, thirty-five rival sponsors and public comps in one place.
Six website concepts, each with its own assistant, built to turn visitors into booked jobs.
